verdict.rationale: Orrick's Tech Studio and Orrick Labs are legal-tech tools, so a natural-language interface is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows form-based document generators, questionnaires, wizards, FAQ/glossary databases and client portals. The GenAI Policy Builder drafts a policy about AI use rather than letting users operate the product by natural language, and nothing documents a chat or natural-language command interface.
